run_GTestJsonOutputUnitTest: run the GTestJsonOutputUnitTest suite to verify Google Test JSON output correctness
test_non_empty_json_output: test that a Google Test binary produces expected non-empty JSON output with failures and disabled tests
test_empty_json_output: test that a Google Test binary with no tests produces an empty JSON output
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in Google Test JSON output is a valid ISO datetime string
test_filtered_json_output: test that applying a gtest_filter flag only includes matching tests in the JSON output
